a.lede: Microsoft announced last month that it will let anyone access Xbox Cloud Gaming in November, without the need to subscribe to Xbox Game Pass. The new pay-as-you-go model will require players to purchase bundles of cloud hours, and now Microsoft is revealing today that bundles will start at $3.99 for 10 hours of cloud playtime. […]
a.title: Xbox Cloud Gaming’s pay-as-you-go option starts at $3.99 for 10 hours

b.lede: Time-based a la carte charges come on top of the purchase price for the games themselves.
b.title: Xbox wants you to pay 24 to 40 cents per hour to stream games you already bought
